editorial.tldr: This is a loose grouping, not one event: three unrelated arXiv papers that share a theme of exactness guarantees for language models. It began with SpecCTMC (Nov 5), exact speculative sampling for diffusion LMs, then a study of small models trained under an exact verifier (Nov 16).
editorial.whats_new: FrontierReplay (Nov 19) proposes exact prefix-cache reuse for hybrid attention/recurrent models, whose in-place state updates normally limit reuse to saved checkpoint positions.
editorial.why_it_matters: Each paper targets a correctness guarantee platform teams usually trade away for speed: unchanged output distributions, verifiable decisions, and exact cache reuse.
editorial.take_for_builders: If you serve hybrid attention/recurrent models, check how your prefix cache handles recurrent state before assuming transformer-style hit rates; otherwise treat these as research to watch, not to deploy.
